note: Inspired by venture return distributions (Horsley Bridge data, Correlation Ventures) and startup lifecycle research (Startup Genome Project)

dead.label: Dead
dead.description: Ran out of cash, shut down, or acqui-hired at <1x invested capital

zombie.label: Zombie
zombie.description: Alive but flat. Revenue covers costs, no growth, cannot raise, founders trapped. The walking dead of startups.

surviving.label: Surviving
surviving.description: Growing but below venture pace. 5-15% MoM revenue growth. Can raise a next round but not at a markup that excites existing investors.

thriving.label: Thriving
thriving.description: 20%+ MoM revenue growth, clear path to next round at 2x+ markup, unit economics improving quarter over quarter. On the venture trajectory.

breakout.label: Breakout
breakout.description: Category-defining trajectory. 30%+ MoM growth sustained, or market leadership in a large TAM, or fundamentally new market creation. The 1% that returns the fund.

pre_seed.success_means: Reach seed round or ramen profitability. Product-market fit signal: 100+ paying users or LOIs from 3+ enterprise customers.

seed.success_means: Reach Series A metrics: $50K+ MRR, <5% monthly churn, repeatable acquisition channel, 3x LTV/CAC.

series_a.success_means: Reach Series B metrics: $200K+ MRR, clear market leadership in segment, gross margins stabilizing above 60%, org scaling from 20 to 80+.

series_b.success_means: Path to profitability visible. $1M+ MRR, international expansion working, or market consolidation via M&A. Could IPO in 3-5 years.

series_c.success_means: Cash-flow positive or clear line to it. Market leader in segment. Strategic acquirer interest or IPO preparation.
